name: How do I choose the right AEO provider for my medical practice?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right AEO provider for my medical practice?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting an AEO provider, consider their experience specifically with medical practices, as healthcare marketing has unique compliance and ethical considerations. Look for providers with a proven track record, transparent reporting, and a deep understanding of AI methodologies in SEO. Evaluate their communication style, client support, and the clarity of their proposed strategies. Request case studies or references from other medical clients to gauge their effectiveness and ensure they align with your practice's goals and values.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose an AEO provider with medical practice experience, a proven track record, transparent reporting, and clear communication, checking references from other healthcare clients.
